description: Sets the order of all properties on the selected wedding's guest site and accommodation screen. The complete list of property names is required; matching ignores case and surrounding spaces. Partial or invalid lists are refused with the current order. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

place_names.description: Complete list of property names in the selected wedding, in the intended display order.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.
